title: KCC GenSan Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Race Was Like
seo_title: KCC GenSan Marathon Review: Field Size, Finish Times, Weather
meta_description: KCC GenSan Marathon review from the 30 August 2025 race at Veranza Mall: almost 5,200 finishers, a 5:43 median marathon, sub-3:26 for the top ten, and 24°C to 27°C overnight.
dek: What the 30 August 2025 race at Veranza Mall Alfresco in General Santos City was like, from the official results and the weather record: how big and how fast the field was, and how warm the night stayed.
verdict: Enter if you want a big, home-town Mindanao race with a distance for everyone. The 2025 race timed almost 5,200 finishers over the marathon, 32 km, half and 10 km, and most of them run to finish: half the marathon field took longer than 5 hours 43, and the median 10 km took 1 hour 40. The front is quick for a provincial race, with a 3:25:39 marathon only just making the top ten and the half-marathon top ten all inside 1:25. Overnight the air stayed warm and damp, 24°C to 27°C with humidity in the 80s, so pace for that rather than a flat city road.

sections.heading: Where It Runs
paragraphs: The race starts and finishes at Veranza Mall Alfresco in General Santos City. The 2025 edition, dated Saturday 30 August 2025, offered five distances: a marathon, 32 km, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km [1]. The 2026 race moves to November and is billed across two dates, 14 and 15 November 2026, at the same venue [2].

sections.heading: The Weather: A Warm, Damp Night
paragraphs: Open-Meteo's historical record for the city shows a warm, humid night. At 9pm on 30 August 2025 it was 26.7°C with 77% humidity; by midnight 25.6°C and 82%; and from 2am to 6am between 24.3°C and 24.9°C, with a dew point of about 22°C and 82% to 88% humidity, and very little wind [3]. It warmed after sunrise to 26.7°C at 7am and 27.9°C at 8am. Earlier on the 30th, the afternoon had peaked at 29.5°C [3].

A dew point near 22°C means sweat evaporates slowly, so the cooler night temperatures help less than they seem. With half the marathon field out for more than 5 hours 43 and the slowest 10% past 7 hours [1], how warm your race is depends on when you finish.

sections.heading: How Fast the Field Is
paragraphs: This is a big field dominated by recreational runners. The 2025 race timed 409 marathon, 306 32 km, 1,005 half-marathon and 3,472 10 km finishers [1]. Half the marathoners took longer than 5:43:11; 7.6% broke 4 hours and 27.6% broke 5 [1]. In the half marathon the median was 2:52:08 and 28.6% finished inside 2:30. The 10 km median was 1:40:40, and only 3.2% broke an hour, which points to a large walking crowd [1].

The front is sharper than the middle. The marathon top ten ran from 2:47:03 to 3:25:39, the half-marathon top ten from 1:09:37 to 1:24:54, and the 10 km top ten from 33:48 to 44:21 [1]. The fastest woman ran the marathon in 3:18:05, and 4:41:15 was tenth among women. Women made up 16.6% of marathon finishers, 30.7% of the half and almost half of the 10 km [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a large, friendly General Santos race with a distance for every level, including the less common 32 km. In the 10 km, an hour puts you in the top 4%; in the marathon, a sub-4 puts you in the top 8%.

Think twice if you want a cool race: even overnight the air in General Santos stayed above 24°C with humidity in the 80s. The 2026 race is on 14 to 15 November 2026 at Veranza Mall Alfresco [2]; check the start times before booking travel.
This review draws on the official 2025 results and historical weather records for General Santos City.

faqs.question: How fast do you need to run to place at the KCC GenSan Marathon?
faqs.answer: Faster than the middle of the field suggests. At the 30 August 2025 race the marathon top ten ran from 2:47:03 to 3:25:39 and the half-marathon top ten from 1:09:37 to 1:24:54. The fastest woman ran the marathon in 3:18:05. Half the marathon field finished after 5:43:11, so a sub-4 marathon put a runner in the top 8%.

faqs.question: How big is the KCC GenSan Marathon?
faqs.answer: More than 5,000 timed finishers. The 30 August 2025 race timed 409 marathon, 306 32 km, 1,005 half-marathon and 3,472 10 km finishers, plus a 5 km. Women made up 16.6% of marathon finishers and 48.6% of the 10 km. The 2026 race is set for 14 to 15 November 2026 at Veranza Mall Alfresco.

faqs.question: How hot is the KCC GenSan Marathon?
faqs.answer: Warm and humid even at night. On the night of 30 to 31 August 2025, historical records for General Santos City show 26.7°C at 9pm, then 24°C to 25°C from 2am to 6am, with a dew point near 22°C and 82% to 88% humidity. It was 27.9°C by 8am, so slower marathoners finish in rising heat.

editorial_notes: Reinstated 2026-11-06: official results for the 2025 edition are now on file, so the race has a documented past edition. Written about the 2025 race (results dated 30 August 2025, Veranza Mall Alfresco). Stats use chip times, excluding results whose chip time is more than 20 minutes faster than the gun time (38 10 km rows, including 25:02 and 27:42 women's times against gun times near 2 hours; the official women's 10 km winner ran 43:04); top-ten bands are the official gun-time rankings. The 32 km is counted but not analysed. Start times, cut-offs, aid stations and route were not found, so those sections are omitted, and the weather is given for the whole night rather than at a start time. Weather is Open-Meteo historical (General Santos airport METAR has no night observations). The 2026 page lists 14 to 15 November 2026. Runners are not named. No rating.
